title: Aft Y-Promenade Wind Funnel at High Cruising Speed
impact: When sailing at 19+ knots, the open Y-shaped World Promenade experiences noticeable sea-breeze turbulence near the base of the Venom Drop slide.
mitigation: Utilize the climate-controlled indoor World Galleria on Deck 6 when sea breezes are strong.
evidence: Recorded wind sensor readings on Mediterranean sea days.
